## Glossary

**AppTheme / SpaceTheme**  
Complete platform theme type; nullable, all-optional tenant override type with bare HSL colors and logo/favicon.

**buttonVariants**  
CVA class generator to style a link or other element like a Button.

**cn**  
clsx + tailwind-merge helper for conditional class names.

**color-mix shades**  
--primary-1..4 derived by mixing with white (light) or black (dark) unless a space overrides them.

**DetailPanel / MasterDetailLayout**  
Scrolling detail view with fixed header; list pane beside detail pane.

**disabledText**  
Button/Input/DropdownMenuItem prop that disables the element and shows why.

**EmptyState**  
Icon/title/description/action block; Table renders it automatically for empty data.

**Modal**  
Dialog with size and dismissOnBackdrop; its close button continues an active flow.

**no-radix**  
CI rule forbidding Radix UI imports (menus/selects use Ariakit).

**organize by domain**  
Components go in the folder of the domain that uses them (settings/CreateTokenModal), not components/modals/.

**Page**  
Standard page body: title, description?, actions?, children.

**PasswordInput**  
Input with a show/hide toggle for secrets.

**primitives**  
packages/ui/src/components/primitives: Shadcn-based base UI (Button, Input, Card, Table, Select, ...).

**ProfileFormCard**  
Name/slug form shared by the three profile pages; showThemeToggle adds the theme picker.

**ResponsiveDrawer**  
Right drawer at or above breakpoint (default md), Modal below; recommended for detail views.

**SearchableSelect**  
Select with a search box; filters locally, or calls onSearch debounced for API search.

**SecretRevealModal**  
Shows a newly created secret once with a copy button.

**show**  
Standard prop: boolean or () => boolean; false renders null.

**SlugInput**  
Input that normalizes typed or pasted text to a slug.

**Table**  
Column-defined list with empty state, pagination or infiniteScroll, sticky header, no virtualization.

**@template/ui**  
Package holding all frontend components, hooks, store, pages and guards; @template/shared holds isomorphic code only.

**theme-layout**  
Class: the AppShell layout system (Page, overlays, panels) and the multi-tier theme.

**three-tier theme**  
--app-* platform colors -> --space-* tenant overrides -> active tokens (--primary) that components use.

**toast / Toaster**  
App toast helper with defaults (use instead of sonner) and the container mounted once in __root.

**ui-components**  
Class: packages/ui primitives, settings pages, modals and the standard conditional props.

**useDarkMode / useThemePersistence**  
Apply .dark on <html> from ui.theme; load/save ui.theme in localStorage.

**useMediaQuery / useBreakpoint**  
Arbitrary media query match; named Tailwind breakpoint match.

**useSpaceTheme**  
Sets --space-* CSS properties from a SpaceTheme; not yet wired by any app.

## 1. What this Warden covers

The shared visual building blocks in @template/ui: Shadcn/Ariakit-based primitives with standard conditional props, domain-organized composed components (settings, users, organizations, utility), the page and overlay layout components, and the three-tier CSS-variable theme with dark mode.

## 2. The domain

All frontend UI lives in @template/ui (packages/ui/src), organized by domain rather than technical type: primitives/ for base UI, settings/, users/, organizations/, auth/, layout/ and utility/ for composed pieces, and pages/ for whole pages that thin app routes mount. Reuse a primitive before creating a component. Most primitives take `show` (false renders null), and Button, Input and DropdownMenuItem also take `disabledText` (disables and explains why), so permission gating is a prop, not a wrapping conditional. Choose by need: Input / PasswordInput (secrets) / SlugInput (slugs); Select for short fixed lists, SearchableSelect for long or server-searched ones; Table (columns, keyExtractor, empty, pagination or infiniteScroll) renders EmptyState itself; CopyButton, SecretRevealModal (one-time secrets), toast (not sonner directly) and ProfileFormCard are the ready answers to recurring screens. List pages share one shape: Page with a create action, a Table, and optimistic create/delete. Class names merge with cn; Radix imports are forbidden by CI (no-radix).

Layout components read the shared store themselves. Page is the standard page body (title, description, actions). For overlays, ResponsiveDrawer (side drawer on desktop, Modal below the breakpoint) is the recommended detail view; Modal is for forms, confirmations and focused actions, and its close button becomes the next step during an active flow. DetailPanel and MasterDetailLayout cover split views. Theme is three tiers of CSS variables in packages/shared/styles/theme.css: --app-* platform baseline, --space-* tenant overrides, and active tokens like --primary that components reference, with shades 1-4 derived by color-mix (white in light, black in dark). useThemePersistence, useDarkMode and ThemeToggle drive light/dark/system from ui.theme; useSpaceTheme applies a SpaceTheme (bare HSL values) but is not wired to data yet (white-labeling is not built).

Not here: the shell's navigation behavior (AppShell, Sidebar, ContextSelector, nav config, routes and guards belong to frontend-apps-navigation); data fetching, query hooks and the pagination/infinite data hooks behind Table (frontend-state-api-client); what a permission check decides (permissions region); sign-in forms' auth logic (auth region).

### Class `ui-components`: packages/ui primitives, settings pages, modals, standard conditional props

- **Avatar** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Avatar.tsx#Avatar`: frame a user picture with image and fallback, optionally hidden
- **Badge** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Badge.tsx#Badge`: render a small rounded pill label with a styled variant
- **Breadcrumb** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx#Breadcrumb`: render an accessible breadcrumb trail nav for page hierarchy
- **Button** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Button.tsx#Button`: Gate visibility via show/disabledText here instead of wrapping in conditionals; menu actions use DropdownMenuItem.
- **buttonVariants** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Button.tsx#buttonVariants`: Rendering a real button: use Button; only use buttonVariants to style links or other elements like a button.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* copying Button's Tailwind classes onto a Link or anchor to make it look like a button (catalog entry buttonVariants)
- **Card** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Card.tsx#Card`: wrap content in a bordered card panel, optionally hidden via show flag or function
- **cn** `packages/shared/src/utils/cn.ts#cn`: merge conditional Tailwind class names, resolving conflicts
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* template-string or array.join class concatenation, or importing clsx/tailwind-merge directly (catalog entry cn; Frontend class utils in shared)
- **cn** `packages/ui/src/lib/utils.ts#cn`: merge conditional Tailwind class names, resolving conflicting utilities
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* template-string or array.join class concatenation, or importing clsx/tailwind-merge directly (catalog entry cn; Frontend class utils in shared)
- **ComingSoon** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/ComingSoon.tsx#ComingSoon`: show a placeholder card for unbuilt features
- **CopyButton** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/CopyButton.tsx#CopyButton`: Copy-to-clipboard actions: use CopyButton instead of a plain Button with a hand-written clipboard handler.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a plain Button with navigator.clipboard.writeText and a local copied-state timer (catalog entry CopyButton)
- **DropdownMenu** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/DropdownMenu.tsx#DropdownMenu`: provide an Ariakit menu context wrapping trigger and content of a dropdown
- **EmptyState** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/EmptyState.tsx#EmptyState`: Tables render it automatically via empty.title/emptyMessage; use directly only for custom non-table views.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a hand-written 'No items yet' block rendered when a Table's data is empty, instead of Table's empty / emptyMessage (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Table (empty data renders EmptyState))
- **enumToSelectOptions** `packages/ui/src/lib/enumOptions.ts#enumToSelectOptions`: Need only a label string: formatEnumLabel instead.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* Object.values(MyEnum).map(v => ({ value: v, label: ...hand-formatted })) to build select options (catalog entry enumToSelectOptions)
- **formatEnumLabel** `packages/ui/src/lib/enumOptions.ts#formatEnumLabel`: Building a whole select option list: enumToSelectOptions instead.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* ad-hoc regex/split to turn camelCase or snake_case enum values into labels (catalog entry formatEnumLabel)
- **Input** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Input.tsx#Input`: Secrets: PasswordInput; slug fields: SlugInput instead.
- **InviteUserModal** `packages/ui/src/components/users/InviteUserModal.tsx#InviteUserModal`: collect an email and role to invite a user, in a modal
- **Label** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Label.tsx#Label`: render a styled form label bound to an input id
- **NotFound** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/NotFound.tsx#NotFound`: Inside an app shell; outside any shell at root router level use RootNotFound.
- **PasswordInput** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/PasswordInput.tsx#PasswordInput`: Secrets needing reveal toggle; plain text uses Input.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* an Input with type toggled between password and text and an eye-icon button written inline (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Input & Label)
- **ProfileFormCard** `packages/ui/src/components/settings/ProfileFormCard.tsx#ProfileFormCard`: Shared by the three profile pages; reuse it instead of composing Input, SlugInput and ThemeToggle by hand.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a profile page composing name Input, SlugInput and ThemeToggle by hand (catalog entry ProfileFormCard; docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Settings)
- **RootNotFound** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/RootNotFound.tsx#RootNotFound`: Root router fallback without dashboard action; within app pages use NotFound.
- **SearchableSelect** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/SearchableSelect.tsx#SearchableSelect`: Long or server-searched option lists; short fixed lists: Select instead.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a custom combobox, or a Select plus a separate search Input that filters options by hand (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Select and SearchableSelect)
- **SecretRevealModal** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/SecretRevealModal.tsx#SecretRevealModal`: Any one-time secret display (API tokens, webhook secrets) instead of a custom modal.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a custom modal that displays a new API token or webhook secret with its own copy logic (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Modals and Pages; catalog entry SecretRevealModal)
- **Select** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Select.tsx#Select`: Short fixed option lists; needs typing to filter or remote search: SearchableSelect instead.
- **SettingsLayout** `packages/ui/src/components/settings/SettingsLayout.tsx#SettingsLayout`: Not mounted by any app route yet; use for new settings pages instead of building tab layouts.
- **ShareButton** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/ShareButton.tsx#ShareButton`: copy the current page link to clipboard with copied feedback
- **SlugInput** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/SlugInput.tsx#SlugInput`: Slug fields; plain text: Input, secrets: PasswordInput.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* an Input whose onChange lowercases and replaces spaces/symbols to build a slug by hand (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Input & Label)
- **Table** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Table.tsx#Table`: Standard list pages: pair with Page and useOptimisticMutation; pass infiniteScroll instead of pagination for load-more lists.
- **ThemeToggle** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/ThemeToggle.tsx#ThemeToggle`: Inside profile forms, set ProfileFormCard showThemeToggle instead of placing it manually.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a custom light/dark/system switch writing localStorage, or placing ThemeToggle manually in a profile form instead of showThemeToggle (catalog entry ThemeToggle; docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § ThemeToggle)
- **toast** `packages/ui/src/lib/toast.ts#toast`: Use instead of calling sonner directly so app-wide toast defaults apply.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* importing toast from sonner directly, bypassing app-wide defaults (catalog entry toast)
- **Toaster** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/Toaster.tsx#Toaster`: mount the app-wide toast container at top-right with close buttons
- **Unauthorized** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/Unauthorized.tsx#Unauthorized`: Permission failure: Unauthorized; missing route: NotFound/RootNotFound instead.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a hand-written access-denied message, or NotFound shown on a permission failure (catalog entry Unauthorized)
- **useBreakpoint** `packages/ui/src/hooks/useMediaQuery.ts#useBreakpoint`: Standard breakpoints: this; arbitrary media queries: useMediaQuery.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* window.innerWidth checks or a resize listener for lg/md, or useMediaQuery('(min-width: 1024px)') for a named breakpoint (catalog entries useBreakpoint, useMediaQuery)
- **useDarkMode** `packages/ui/src/hooks/useDarkMode.ts#useDarkMode`: toggle the .dark class on <html> for light, dark or system theme
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* toggling document.documentElement.classList 'dark' or reading prefers-color-scheme by hand (docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § Hooks)
- **useMediaQuery** `packages/ui/src/hooks/useMediaQuery.ts#useMediaQuery`: Named sm–2xl widths: useBreakpoint instead.
- **useSpaceTheme** `packages/ui/src/hooks/useSpaceTheme.ts#useSpaceTheme`: apply a space's theme as --space-* CSS properties, clearing previous keys
- **no-radix** `scripts/ci/rules/no-radix.sh`: CI check forbidding Radix UI imports
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* importing @radix-ui/* (e.g. a shadcn generator's default menu or select) (scripts/ci/rules/no-radix.sh (CI rule))
- **Context-adaptive pages** `ProfilePage`: Pages differing by organization/space/user context; avoid separate routes per context.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* separate route files per context (user/org/space) for what is one page, instead of one page that picks its view from tenant context like ProfilePage (catalog entry ProfilePage)
- **IntegrationsPage provider buckets** `IntegrationsPage, lib/integrationProviders.ts`: list integrations per provider bucket plus Custom, status from bucket total
- **List page shape** `packages/ui/src/pages/OrganizationsPage`: build list screens as Page with create action, Table, optimistic create/delete
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a list screen with its own header/layout markup, ad-hoc delete refetch and custom table instead of Page + Table + useOptimisticMutation (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Modals and Pages (list pages share one shape))
- **Modal close continues flow** `packages/ui Modal`: turn an open modal's close button into the flow's next action
- **Pages in packages/ui mounted by thin app routes** `packages/ui/src/pages/`: Page-level screens; app route files stay thin instead of holding page logic.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* page logic, queries and components written inside apps/*/app/routes files or an app-local components folder (docs/claude/FRONTEND.md § Conventions (shared UI and pages in @template/ui; app routes stay thin); docs/claude/APPS.md § Implementation Notes)
- **Settings visibility via nav config** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#Settings`: Use instead of hiding entries inside pages.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a settings page that hides its own entries or tabs based on permissions (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Settings)
- **Shared pages in @template/ui/pages** `packages/ui/src/pages/`: keep app screens in the shared pages package, mounted by thin app routes
- **apiMutation** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#Modals and Pages`: Writes; apiQuery for reads.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a mutationFn that calls fetch or the SDK directly and attaches Authorization / x-spoof-user-email headers by hand (docs/claude/FRONTEND/API_CLIENT.md § apiQuery and apiMutation; FEATURES.md § Frontend Architecture (API Client Wrappers))
- **apiQuery** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#Modals and Pages`: Reads; apiMutation for writes.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a hand-written fetch/axios call or inline queryFn that builds headers and unwraps data.data itself, or a useQuery whose queryKey is a hand-made array instead of the SDK's generated query key (docs/claude/FRONTEND/API_CLIENT.md § apiQuery and apiMutation; catalog entry apiQuery)
- **Core UI primitives** `packages/ui (Shadcn-based)`: Reuse before creating a new component.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a new bespoke button, input, card, select or table component, or raw <button>/<input>/<table> markup with hand-written Tailwind, where a packages/ui primitive exists (FEATURES.md § UI Components; catalog/doc member Core UI primitives (reuse before creating))
- **createOptimisticListTarget** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#Modals and Pages`: describe which cached list query an optimistic mutation updates and how
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* hand-written optimisticUpdate/reconcile functions that insert a placeholder row, filter by id or splice the response item into a cached list (docs/claude/FRONTEND/API_CLIENT.md § Optimistic Mutations)
- **CreateOrganizationModal** `packages/ui/src/components/organizations/`: collect organization name and auto-derived, uniqueness-validated slug
- **disabledText prop** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/ (Button, Input, DropdownMenuItem)`: Show why an action is unavailable; use show to hide it instead.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a disabled button with a separate tooltip or helper text explaining why, instead of disabledText (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Standard Conditional Props)
- **ErrorBoundary** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/`: catch render errors and show a fallback
- **Pagination** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/`: Usually via Table's pagination prop rather than standalone.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* rendering a separate Pagination under a Table instead of passing pagination props to Table (catalog/doc member Pagination (with Table pass paginationProps))
- **ProfilePage** `packages/ui/src/pages/`: Mount in settings/profile; specific *ProfilePage only when context is fixed.
- **show prop** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/`: Hide unauthorized UI entirely; use disabledText to keep it visible but disabled.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* conditional rendering wrappers around Card, Table, Avatar or EmptyState instead of their show prop (docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Standard Conditional Props)
- **Table + Pagination** `Table, Pagination`: Fixed pages via usePaginatedData; infinite scroll via useInfiniteData.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a hand-built table with its own page-number buttons, IntersectionObserver load-more or page state (FEATURES.md § UI Components (Table + Pagination); docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md § Table)
- **useInfiniteDataQuery** `IntegrationsPage`: Lists that overflow one page (e.g. 100-item buckets); useQuery for bounded lists.
- **useInfiniteScrollTrigger** `IntegrationsPage`: load the next page when the list end scrolls into view
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* A hand-written IntersectionObserver sentinel or scroll listener to trigger loading the next page. (docs/claude/FRONTEND/API_CLIENT.md § Infinite Scroll Trigger)
- **useOptimisticMutation** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#Modals and Pages`: List create/delete; plain useMutation when no cached list needs updating.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a raw useMutation with hand-written onMutate setQueryData, snapshot/rollback in onError and invalidateQueries in onSettled for a list (docs/claude/FRONTEND/API_CLIENT.md § Optimistic Mutations; catalog entry useOptimisticMutation)
- **useSectionOpen** `packages/ui`: keep a modal's open state in the URL hash for deep links
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* useState for a modal or collapsible that should survive reload or be deep-linkable, or hand-writing window.location.hash (catalog entry useSectionOpen)
- **useValidateUniqueness** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/API_CLIENT.md#form-helpers`: check a form field value is unique via the API
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a hand-written SDK read or fetch in a form effect to check whether a slug or name is already taken (docs/claude/FRONTEND/API_CLIENT.md § Form Helpers (useValidateUniqueness); CreateOrganizationModal)
- **All frontend code lives in @template/ui** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md — Package Organization`: Deciding package for frontend code; API client goes in @template/sdk, isomorphic code in @template/shared.
- **Organize components by domain** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md — Package Organization`: Any new shared UI component in @template/ui.
- **Settings are nested routes, not tabs** `apps/{web,admin}/app/routes/_authenticated/settings/`: Any new settings screen; SettingsLayout tabs are exported but unmounted.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a new settings screen added as a tab inside SettingsLayout instead of a nested route under _authenticated/settings/ (catalog/doc member Settings are nested routes, not tabs)
- *Also here, by name:* AuthProviderModal (`packages/ui/src/components/settings/AuthProviderModal.tsx`); AvatarFallback (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Avatar.tsx`); AvatarImage (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Avatar.tsx`); BreadcrumbEllipsis (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx`); BreadcrumbItem (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx`); BreadcrumbLink (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx`); BreadcrumbList (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx`); BreadcrumbPage (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx`); BreadcrumbSeparator (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx`); CardContent (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Card.tsx`); CardDescription (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Card.tsx`); CardFooter (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Card.tsx`); CardHeader (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Card.tsx`); CardTitle (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Card.tsx`); CreateIntegrationModal (`packages/ui/src/components/settings/CreateIntegrationModal.tsx`); CreateTokenModal (`packages/ui/src/components/settings/CreateTokenModal.tsx`); CreateWebhookModal (`packages/ui/src/components/settings/CreateWebhookModal.tsx`); DropdownMenuContent (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/DropdownMenu.tsx`); DropdownMenuItem (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/DropdownMenu.tsx`); DropdownMenuLabel (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/DropdownMenu.tsx`); DropdownMenuSeparator (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/DropdownMenu.tsx`); DropdownMenuTrigger (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/DropdownMenu.tsx`); UserProfileTab (`packages/ui/src/components/settings/UserProfileTab.tsx`); UserWebhooksTab (`packages/ui/src/components/settings/UserWebhooksTab.tsx`); badgeVariants (`packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Badge.tsx`)

### Class `theme-layout`: AppShell layout system and multi-tier theme

- **DetailPanel** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/DetailPanel.tsx#DetailPanel`: lay out a scrolling detail view with a fixed header and optional split
- **MasterDetailLayout** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/MasterDetailLayout.tsx#MasterDetailLayout`: Side-by-side list and detail; for an overlay detail view use ResponsiveDrawer instead.
- **Modal** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/Modal.tsx#Modal`: Plain dialog; for detail views prefer ResponsiveDrawer, which becomes a Modal on small screens.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a custom dialog with its own backdrop, Escape handling and close button (docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § Overlays and Panels)
- **Page** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/Page.tsx#Page`: Standard body for every page, e.g. list pages with a Table; MasterDetailLayout only for split views.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* each page hand-writing its own title row, description and actions container (docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § Header and Page)
- **ResponsiveDrawer** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/ResponsiveDrawer.tsx#ResponsiveDrawer`: Recommended for detail views over raw Modal; use Modal for confirmations and forms.
- **Root component app hooks** `apps/{web,admin,superadmin}/app/routes/__root.tsx`: install navigation, meta, language, theme, websocket and dark mode hooks once at root
- **Shade generation via color-mix** `packages/shared/styles/theme.css`: derive shades 1–4 by mixing with white in light, black in dark mode
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* hand-defined light/dark shade variables for a color instead of the color-mix derived --*-1..4 (docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § Theme System)
- **Three-tier theme CSS variables** `packages/shared/styles/theme.css`: layer platform colors, tenant overrides and active tokens components reference
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* hard-coded hex/Tailwind palette colors (bg-blue-600) in components instead of the active theme tokens (--primary and shades) (docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § Theme System (Architecture))
- **AppShell** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: Every authenticated page; superadmin locks context and hides spoof controls.
- **AppTheme** `packages/ui/src/types/AppTheme.ts`: platform baseline; SpaceTheme for tenant overrides
- **ContextSelector** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: switch active tenant between Personal, organizations and spaces
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a custom org/space dropdown, or passing tenant/auth to ContextSelector as props (docs/claude/ZUSTAND.md § 3. TenantSlice (ContextSelector reads tenant and auth itself); catalog entry ContextSelector)
- **FullscreenLayout** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: Routes under _fullscreen instead of AppShell/Page.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a page that hides AppShell chrome by hand or builds its own back button that drops org/space/spoof (docs/claude/FRONTEND/ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md § File-Based Routes (FullscreenLayout back button uses navigatePreserving))
- **Header** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: show mobile menu button, breadcrumbs from nav chain and share button
- **Layout components** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: provide shell, sidebar, header, page, modal, drawer and master-detail layouts
- **navigatePreserving** `Sidebar navigation`: In-app navigation that must keep ?org=/?space=; plain navigate loses context.
- **Sidebar** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: render context nav items, hiding failed-access and alias items
- **SpaceTheme** `packages/ui/src/types/SpaceTheme.ts`: tenant partial overrides; AppTheme for the complete platform theme
- **tenant.setOrganization** `tenant store`: Organization context; tenant.setSpace for a space.
- **tenant.setSpace** `tenant store`: Space context; tenant.setOrganization for an organization.
- **useLanguage** `packages/ui/src/hooks/useLanguage.ts`: set document lang attribute from the browser language
- **UserMenu** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: show user identity with settings, logout and superadmin spoof controls
- **useThemePersistence** `packages/ui/src/hooks/useThemePersistence.ts`: load localStorage theme into store on mount and save changes back
- **Detail views use ResponsiveDrawer** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md#Overlays and Panels`: Showing a record detail, profile or settings panel as an overlay.
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* a record detail or profile panel built as a centered Modal or a custom slide-over with its own breakpoint logic (docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § Overlays and Panels (ResponsiveDrawer recommended for detail views))
- **Layout components read the store** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`: Any authenticated layout composition in web, admin or superadmin apps.
- **Theme colors as bare HSL** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md#Types`: any SpaceTheme or AppTheme color value
  - *Signs you're bypassing it:* SpaceTheme/AppTheme values written as '#7c3aed' or 'hsl(262 80% 46%)' instead of '262 80% 46%' (docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md § Types)

## 4. The specifics, in full

### 4a. Doc sections

Each unit is the doc section verbatim, with its headings shifted down two levels. A source line above it gives the path, the section and the doc's H1.

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#package-organization -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md` § Package Organization (in "Frontend Components")

#### Package Organization

**Location:** `packages/ui/src/`

All frontend code (components, hooks, store, pages, guards) lives in `@template/ui`. `@template/shared` holds isomorphic code only (logger, errors, bracket query, rules); the API client is `@template/sdk`.

Components are organized by **domain** (not technical type):

```
packages/ui/src/components/
├── auth/              # LoginForm, SignupForm, AuthDivider, SocialAuthButton
├── flows/             # FlowBanner (see FLOWS.md)
├── inquiries/         # InquirySourceControls, InquiryTargetControls
├── layout/            # AppShell, Sidebar, ContextSelector, Header, Breadcrumbs, Modal, drawers
├── organizations/     # CreateOrganizationModal
├── primitives/        # Base UI (Button, Input, Card, Table, Select, …)
├── settings/          # Settings modals and cards
├── users/             # InviteUserModal
└── utility/           # ErrorBoundary, NotFound, Unauthorized, Toaster, SecretRevealModal, …
```

**Rule:** Put components where they're used, not by technical type.
- ✅ `components/settings/CreateTokenModal.tsx`
- ❌ `components/modals/CreateTokenModal.tsx`

Whole pages live in `packages/ui/src/pages/` and are mounted by thin app routes (`component: TokensPage`).

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#standard-conditional-props -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md` § Standard Conditional Props (in "Frontend Components")

#### Standard Conditional Props

Most primitives take `show`:

```typescript
show?: boolean | (() => boolean);   // false → the component renders null (default: true)
```

`Button` and `Input` also take `disabledText`. Setting it **disables** the element and replaces the button text / input placeholder with it. `DropdownMenuItem` takes `show`, `disabled` (boolean or function) and `disabledText`.

| Component | `show` | `disabledText` |
|-----------|--------|----------------|
| Button, Input | ✅ | ✅ |
| DropdownMenuItem | ✅ | ✅ (`disabled` may be a function) |
| Card, Table, Avatar, EmptyState | ✅ | — |

```typescript
<Button show={() => permissions.check('organization', org, 'manage')}>Edit Organization</Button>

<Button disabledText={canDelete ? undefined : 'Requires Owner'}>Delete Organization</Button>

<Card show={() => evaluate(displayRules, { user, context })}>…</Card>
```

Permission checks that feed these props: [PERMISSIONS.md](../PERMISSIONS.md#frontend-checks).

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#ui-primitives -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md` § UI Primitives (in "Frontend Components")

#### UI Primitives

**Location:** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/`

##### Button

CVA variants: `default`, `destructive`, `outline`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `link`; sizes `sm`, `default`, `lg`, `icon`. Accepts all `<button>` props plus `show` and `disabledText`.

```typescript
<Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
<Button variant="outline" size="sm">Edit</Button>
```

##### Input & Label

`Input` accepts `<input>` props plus `show` and `disabledText`. Variants: `PasswordInput` (show/hide toggle), `SlugInput` (`onChange(value)` with slug normalization).

```typescript
<div className="space-y-2">
  <Label htmlFor="email">Email Address</Label>
  <Input id="email" type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
</div>
```

##### Card

**Components:** Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter

```typescript
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Settings</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Manage your account settings</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>{/* Content */}</CardContent>
  <CardFooter>
    <Button>Save Changes</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

##### Table

```typescript
type Column<T> = {
  key: string;
  label: React.ReactNode;
  render?: (item: T) => React.ReactNode;   // default: item[key]
};

type TableProps<T> = {
  columns: Column<T>[];
  data: T[];
  keyExtractor: (item: T) => string;
  onRowClick?: (item: T) => void;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  empty?: { title?: string; description?: string; icon?: string; action?: { label; onClick } };
  show?: boolean | (() => boolean);
  pagination?: PaginationProps;
  infiniteScroll?: { onLoadMore; hasMore; isLoading; rootMargin? };
  maxHeight?: number;
  scrollRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  sectionId?: string;
  className?: string;
};
```

Empty data renders an `EmptyState` (`empty.title` → `emptyMessage` → "Nothing here yet"). Pagination, infinite scroll and section hashes: [API_CLIENT.md](API_CLIENT.md#table-and-pagination).

##### Avatar

Composed: `Avatar` (frame, `show`), `AvatarImage` (renders nothing when `src` is missing or fails to load), `AvatarFallback`.

```typescript
<Avatar className="h-8 w-8">
  <AvatarImage src={user.image ?? undefined} alt={user.name} />
  <AvatarFallback>{user.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</AvatarFallback>
</Avatar>
```

##### EmptyState

```typescript
<EmptyState
  icon="lucide:inbox"
  title="No organizations yet"
  description="Create your first organization to get started"
  action={{ label: 'Create Organization', onClick: () => setIsModalOpen(true) }}
/>
```

##### DropdownMenu

Ariakit menu: `DropdownMenu`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuContent` (`align: 'start' | 'end'`), `DropdownMenuItem` (`onClick`), `DropdownMenuLabel`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`.

```typescript
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <Icon icon="lucide:more-vertical" />
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
    <DropdownMenuItem onClick={handleEdit}>Edit</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem show={canDelete} onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

##### Select and SearchableSelect

`Select` takes `options`, `value`, `onChange(value)`.

`SearchableSelect` is a `Select` with a search box in its popover (Ariakit select + combobox). Same `options` / `value` / `onChange` contract as `Select`. Without `onSearch` it filters the given options by label in memory. With `onSearch` it skips local filtering and calls `onSearch(query)` debounced, so the caller can query the API and pass the results back as `options`. The selected label stays visible after the results change.

```typescript
const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
const { data, isFetching } = useQuery({
  queryKey: adminContactReadManyQueryKey({ query: { search } }),
  queryFn: apiQuery(adminContactReadMany),
});

<SearchableSelect
  aria-label="Recipient"
  options={(data?.data ?? []).map((contact) => ({ value: contact.id, label: contact.valueKey ?? contact.id }))}
  value={contactId}
  onChange={setContactId}
  onSearch={setSearch}
  isLoading={isFetching}
  placeholder="Choose a person"
/>
```

##### Others

`Badge`, `Breadcrumb`, `CopyButton` (`value`, `label?`), `Pagination`, `ThemeToggle` (see [THEME_LAYOUT.md](THEME_LAYOUT.md#themetoggle)).

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#settings -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md` § Settings (in "Frontend Components")

#### Settings

Settings are nested routes, not tabs: `apps/{web,admin}/app/routes/_authenticated/settings/{profile,tokens,webhooks,integrations,authProviders,update,transfer}.tsx` (superadmin: profile, tokens, webhooks, integrations), each mounting a page from `@template/ui/pages`. `settings.tsx` redirects `/settings` to `/settings/profile`. The nav config's settings item decides which entries each context sees (Auth Providers: organization owners; Update / Transfer: spaces).

Pages adapt to the current context. `ProfilePage` switches on `tenant.context.type`:

```typescript
export const ProfilePage = () => {
  const context = useAppStore((state) => state.tenant.context) as AuthenticatedContext;

  switch (context.type) {
    case 'organization':
      return <OrganizationProfilePage />;
    case 'space':
      return <SpaceProfilePage />;
    case 'user':
      return <UserProfilePage />;
  }
};
```

**Components** (`packages/ui/src/components/settings/`):

- `ProfileFormCard` - Name / slug form shared by the three profile pages; `showThemeToggle` adds the theme picker
- `CreateTokenModal` - Token creation modal (API tokens are managed by `TokensPage`, which shows a new key once in `SecretRevealModal`)
- `CreateWebhookModal` - Webhook subscription creation (managed by `WebhooksPage`)
- `CreateIntegrationModal` - Connect flow for one provider, or a custom integration when `provider` is `null` (`undefined` = closed). Integrations are managed by `IntegrationsPage`: one bucket per provider in `lib/integrationProviders.ts` plus a Custom bucket (provider `null`), each its own `searchFields[provider]` query of 100 that infinite-scrolls on overflow (`useInfiniteDataQuery` + `useInfiniteScrollTrigger`); a provider's status comes from its bucket's total
- `AuthProviderModal` - Auth provider configuration modal (managed by `OrganizationAuthProvidersPage`)
- `SettingsLayout`, `UserProfileTab`, `UserWebhooksTab` - tabbed settings container and tabs; exported, not mounted by any app route

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#modals-and-pages -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md` § Modals and Pages (in "Frontend Components")

#### Modals and Pages

- `CreateOrganizationModal` (`components/organizations/`) - `isOpen`, `onClose`, `onSubmit(name, slug)`. Derives the slug from the name until edited, then validates it with `useValidateUniqueness` (see [API_CLIENT.md](API_CLIENT.md#form-helpers)).
- `InviteUserModal` (`components/users/`) - `isOpen`, `onClose`, `onSubmit(email, role)`, optional `title` and `roles`.
- `SecretRevealModal` (`components/utility/`) - shows a secret once with a copy button.

**Pages** (`packages/ui/src/pages/`): `LoginPage`, `SignupPage`, `AuthCallbackPage`, `HomePage`, `OrganizationsPage`, `OrganizationUsersPage`, `OrganizationSpacesPage`, `OrganizationProfilePage`, `SpaceProfilePage`, `UserProfilePage`, `ProfilePage`, `TokensPage`, `WebhooksPage`, `IntegrationsPage`, `OrganizationAuthProvidersPage`, `SegmentsPage`, inquiry pages (`InquiriesPage`, `AdminInquiriesPage`, `SpaceTransferInquiryPage`, `SpaceUpdateInquiryPage`, invitation / application / transfer list pages).

List pages share one shape: a `Page` with a create action, a `Table`, and `useOptimisticMutation` for create / delete:

```typescript
export const OrganizationsPage = () => {
  const permissions = useAppStore((state) => state.permissions);
  const { data } = useQuery({
    queryKey: meReadManyOrganizationsQueryKey(),
    queryFn: apiQuery((opts: Parameters<typeof meReadManyOrganizations>[0]) => meReadManyOrganizations(opts)),
  });

  const deleteMutation = useOptimisticMutation({
    mutationFn: apiMutation((opts: Parameters<typeof organizationDelete>[0]) => organizationDelete(opts)),
    targets: [createOptimisticListTarget({ queryKey: meReadManyOrganizationsQueryKey(), operation: 'delete' })],
  });
  // <Page title actions={<Button>Create</Button>}><Table … /></Page>
};
```

**Utility** (`components/utility/`): `ErrorBoundary`, `NotFound`, `RootNotFound`, `Unauthorized`, `ComingSoon`, `ShareButton`, `Toaster`.

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md#key-files -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/COMPONENTS.md` § Key Files (in "Frontend Components")

#### Key Files

- `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/` — base UI
- `packages/ui/src/components/{settings,organizations,users,utility}/`
- `packages/ui/src/pages/`

<!-- unit doc:FEATURES.md#ui-components -->
**Source:** `FEATURES.md` § UI Components (in "Template Features")

#### UI Components

**Primitives complete, higher-level components under construction.** Built on Shadcn UI with Tailwind CSS 4.

##### Done (Primitives)

- ✅ **Core Primitives** - Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Card, DropdownMenu, EmptyState, Input, Label, Pagination, PasswordInput, Select, SlugInput, Table, ThemeToggle

- ✅ **AppShell** - Main application layout with sidebar, header, and breadcrumb navigation. Wires to Zustand store for current user, org, space

- ✅ **Sidebar** - Collapsible navigation menu with permission-based item filtering, active state, and route highlighting

- ✅ **UserMenu** - Profile dropdown with avatar, name, email, logout, and spoof badge for impersonation

- ✅ **ContextSelector** - Dropdown for switching organizations and spaces, updates URL params and global state

- ✅ **Table + Pagination** - Table primitive with fixed-page pagination (page numbers, per-page selector, record count) and infinite scroll (IntersectionObserver sentinel). Supports viewport scroll with sticky headers and window scroll. All items rendered in DOM (no virtualization) so text selection, Ctrl+F, and copy-paste work.

- ✅ **Data Hooks** - `usePaginatedData` and `useInfiniteData` manage search, filter, sort, and pagination state. `makeDataConfig` auto-generates configuration from the OpenAPI spec (searchable fields, orderable fields, enum filters). Scroll position persisted in `history.state` for back/forward restoration. Optional shareable URL sync (`?page=3&search=acme`).

- ✅ **Section Hash Navigation** - `useSectionHash` auto-discovers `data-section` elements via MutationObserver, syncs URL hash to most visible section. Dot-notation deep linking (`#usersTable.usr_abc123`) scrolls to specific rows.

##### In Progress

- 🟡 **Form Components** - React Hook Form + Zod integration partially done; full component set (checkbox, radio, switch, date picker) still being built out

- 🟡 **Page-level components** - Higher-level composed pages (OrganizationsPage, UsersPage, etc.) under active development

- 🟣 Visual JSON editor (ticket DEV-002)

<!-- unit doc:FEATURES.md#frontend-hooks -->
**Source:** `FEATURES.md` § Frontend Hooks (in "Template Features")

#### Frontend Hooks

**20+ Custom Hooks for Common Patterns** - Reusable logic extracted into hooks for consistency across apps. All hooks are type-safe, tested, and follow React best practices.

- ✅ **useAuthenticatedRouting()** - Initializes authentication state, syncs URL params (`?org=`, `?space=`) with store, handles redirects for auth/public routes. Call once in root component - sets up entire auth flow

- ✅ **useOptimisticMutation()** - Wrapper around TanStack Query mutations with optimistic updates for list operations. Instantly updates UI on create/update/delete, automatically rolls back on error. Prevents loading states for better UX

- ✅ **useValidateUniqueness()** - Real-time uniqueness validation for form fields (email, username, slug). Debounces input, calls API to check uniqueness, returns validation error. Integrates with React Hook Form

- ✅ **useEventRefetch()** - Subscribes to custom events and refetches TanStack Query queries when events fire. Use for cross-component data invalidation (user created in modal, refetch user list in table)

- ✅ **useBreadcrumbs()** - Generates breadcrumb trail from current route using navigation config. Returns array of `{ label, path }` objects for rendering breadcrumb navigation

- ✅ **useAuthStrategy()** - Detects and configures multi-provider authentication (email/password, OAuth, SAML). Returns available providers, handles provider selection, manages auth flow

- ✅ **usePermission()** - Checks if current user has specific permission in current context. Returns boolean for conditional rendering. Reacts to context switches (org/space changes)

- ✅ **useDebounce()** - Debounces rapidly changing values (search input, filter selections). Prevents excessive API calls. Configurable delay, cancels pending updates on unmount

- ✅ **useMediaQuery()** - Responsive design helper that returns boolean for media query matches. Use for conditional rendering based on screen size. Server-safe (returns false during SSR)

- ✅ **useAuthProviders()** - Fetches available auth providers for current org or platform. Used by login/signup to render correct OAuth buttons, show SSO option, or show password field based on configured providers
- ✅ **useAppEvents()** - Subscribes to named DOM custom events for cross-component communication. Pair with `useEventRefetch()` to trigger query invalidations without prop drilling or shared state
- ✅ **useDarkMode()** - Reads and sets theme preference (light/dark/system). Syncs with Zustand ui slice, persists across sessions, applies Tailwind `dark:` class to document root. Returns `{ theme, setTheme, isDark }`
- ✅ **useLanguage()** - Returns current locale string and setter. Backed by Zustand ui slice. Ready for i18n integration — currently returns `en` as default, locale-aware components read from this hook
- ✅ **usePageMeta()** - Sets `document.title` and meta description for the current route. Accepts raw strings or template with app name. Called in page components to keep browser tab titles contextual
- 🟡 **useSpaceTheme()** - Hook exists but returns mock values; space theming not yet wired to real data

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/APPS.md#white-label-mode -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/APPS.md` § White-Label Mode (in "App Structure")

#### White-Label Mode

**Not built.** The pieces that exist: `AppShell`'s `lockedContext` prop renders the
ContextSelector read-only (superadmin uses it), and `useSpaceTheme` sets per-space CSS
variables. There is no subdomain detection, space-by-subdomain lookup, or per-space
branding data; see `tickets/FEAT-007-white-labeling.md`.

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md#layout-system -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md` § Layout System (in "Frontend Layout and Theme")

#### Layout System

**Location:** `packages/ui/src/components/layout/`

Layout components read the shared store themselves; apps pass almost nothing.

##### AppShell

**Master layout wrapper** for all authenticated pages.

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Sidebar (w-64)     │ Header (breadcrumbs) │
│ ─────────────────  │──────────────────────│
│ AppIdentity        │                      │
│ ContextSelector    │  children            │
│ ─────────────────  │                      │
│ Sidebar nav        │                      │
│ ─────────────────  │                      │
│ Support (optional) │                      │
│ UserMenu           │                      │
└───────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

```typescript
type AppShellProps = {
  onSupport?: () => void;        // Shows a Support button
  lockedContext?: boolean;       // ContextSelector without the dropdown
  showSpoofControls?: boolean;   // Default true
  children: React.ReactNode;
};
```

```typescript
// Web / admin
<AppShell>
  <ErrorBoundary>{isAuthorized ? <Outlet /> : <Unauthorized />}</ErrorBoundary>
</AppShell>

// Superadmin
<AppShell lockedContext={true} showSpoofControls={false}>…</AppShell>
```

Below `lg` the sidebar is an off-canvas drawer opened from the Header's menu button.

##### ContextSelector

Dropdown to switch between Personal and the user's organizations and spaces (from `auth.organizations` / `auth.spaces`).

- Organization with 0 spaces → one item, switches to the organization.
- Organization with 1 space → one item, switches to that space.
- Organization with 2+ spaces → accordion listing its spaces plus the organization itself.
- Each multi-space organization's accordion has a Manage item; `onManageOrganizations` adds a "Your Organizations" item.
- `locked` → shows the current context label with no dropdown (superadmin).

Switching calls `tenant.setOrganization(id)` / `tenant.setSpace(id)`; the URL `?org=` / `?space=` follow.

##### Sidebar

Renders `navigation.navConfig[tenant.context.type]`. Items whose `access` fails and `alias` items are skipped; children nest three levels below the top and auto-expand along the active route. Clicking navigates with `navigatePreserving(fullPath, 'context')`. Nav config format: [ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md](ROUTING_NAVIGATION.md#navigation).

##### UserMenu

Avatar with initials fallback, name, and email (or "Spoofing"). Actions: Settings, Log out, and — for superadmins or while spoofing, when `showSpoofControls` — a spoof email field with Spoof / Exit.

##### Header and Page

`Header` shows the mobile menu button, `Breadcrumbs` (from the matched nav chain), and `ShareButton` outside the public context.

`Page` is the standard page body: `title`, `description?`, `actions?`, `children`.

```typescript
<Page title="Tokens" description="API keys for this context" actions={<Button>Create</Button>}>
  <Table … />
</Page>
```

##### Overlays and Panels

- **Modal** - `open` (or `isOpen`), `onClose`, `title?`, `size: 'small' | 'large'`, `dismissOnBackdrop` (default true). Closes on Escape. During an active flow the close button becomes the flow's next-step label (see [FLOWS.md](../FLOWS.md)).
- **ResponsiveDrawer** - `open`, `onClose`, `title?`, `breakpoint` (default `md`). Right-side drawer at or above the breakpoint, `Modal` below it. **Recommended for detail views.**
- **DetailPanel** - `header?`, `children`, `split?`.
- **MasterDetailLayout** - `master?`, `detail`.
- **FullscreenLayout** - Used by the `_fullscreen` route layout; a back button over full-width content.

| Component | Desktop | Mobile | Best For |
|-----------|---------|--------|----------|
| **ResponsiveDrawer** | Side drawer | Modal | Detail views, user profiles, settings panels |
| **Modal** | Centered modal | Centered modal | Forms, confirmations, focused actions |

---

<!-- unit doc:docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md#theme-system -->
**Source:** `docs/claude/FRONTEND/THEME_LAYOUT.md` § Theme System (in "Frontend Layout and Theme")

#### Theme System

Multi-tier theming with automatic shade generation and dark mode. Space white-labeling has the CSS and hook in place but is not wired to data yet.

##### Architecture

**Three-tier CSS variable system** (`packages/shared/styles/theme.css`):

```
App Theme (--app-*)     → Platform baseline colors
  ↓
Space Theme (--space-*) → Tenant overrides (set dynamically)
  ↓
Active Theme (--primary) → What components reference
```

**Automatic shade generation** via CSS `color-mix()`:

```css
/* Light mode: mix with white */
:root {
  --primary: var(--space-primary, var(--app-primary));
  --primary-1: var(--space-primary-1, color-mix(in hsl, hsl(var(--primary)), white 60%));
  --primary-2: var(--space-primary-2, color-mix(in hsl, hsl(var(--primary)), white 40%));
  --primary-3: var(--space-primary-3, color-mix(in hsl, hsl(var(--primary)), white 20%));
  --primary-4: var(--space-primary-4, color-mix(in hsl, hsl(var(--primary)), white 10%));
}

/* Dark mode: mix with black */
.dark {
  --primary-1: var(--space-primary-1, color-mix(in hsl, hsl(var(--primary)), black 60%));
  /* ... */
}
```

Same pattern for secondary, tertiary, quaternary and accent. **Browser support:** Chrome 111+, Firefox 113+, Safari 16.2+.

##### Hooks

**Location:** `packages/ui/src/hooks/`

- **`useThemePersistence()`** - Loads `localStorage.theme` into `ui.theme` on mount and saves changes back.
- **`useDarkMode(theme)`** - `'light'` removes `.dark` from `<html>`, `'dark'` adds it, `'system'` reads `prefers-color-scheme` when the theme changes.
- **`useSpaceTheme(spaceTheme)`** - Sets `--space-{key}` CSS properties for each non-empty key; wraps `logo`, `logoDark`, `favicon` in `url()`; clears the previous keys on change or `null`.
- **`useLanguage()`** - Sets `document.documentElement.lang` from the browser language.

##### ThemeToggle

**Location:** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/ThemeToggle.tsx`

Light / dark / system button group bound to `ui.theme`. Shown by `ProfileFormCard` when `showThemeToggle` is set.

##### Types

**Location:** `packages/ui/src/types/`

- `SpaceTheme` - the whole object may be `null`; every property is optional: `primary`, `primary1`–`primary4`, `primaryForeground`, the same for `secondary`, `tertiary`, `quaternary`, `accent`, plus `logo`, `logoDark`, `favicon`. Colors are HSL without the wrapper: `"262 80% 46%"`.
- `AppTheme` - the complete platform theme (all properties required).

##### Usage in Root Component

```typescript
// apps/{web,admin,superadmin}/app/routes/__root.tsx
const RootComponent = () => {
  const theme = useAppStore((state) => state.ui.theme);

  useRegisterNavigation(navConfig);
  usePageMeta();
  useLanguage();
  useThemePersistence();
  useApiWebsocket();
  useDarkMode(theme);

  return (
    <>
      <Toaster />
      <FlowBanner />
      <Outlet />
    </>
  );
};
```

##### White-Labeling

`Space` has `primaryColor` and `logoUrl` columns, and `useSpaceTheme` applies a `SpaceTheme`, but no app calls `useSpaceTheme` yet. Wiring it means passing the page space's theme in `__root.tsx`; shades 1–4 then come from `color-mix()`. Tracked in `tickets/FEAT-007-white-labeling.md`.

##### Testing

```bash
cd packages/ui && bun test
```

- `useDarkMode.test.ts` - Dark class toggling for light/dark/system
- `useSpaceTheme.test.ts` - CSS variable setting, URL wrapping, clearing
- `ThemeToggle.test.tsx` - Theme option rendering and selection

### 4b. Code entries

From the catalog (`.foundry/catalog/catalog.json`, extracted from the code). Each line: **name** `where` [kind] the job it does. Use: canonical usage.

#### Class `ui-components`
- **Avatar** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Avatar.tsx#Avatar` [primitive] frame a user picture with image and fallback, optionally hidden Use: <Avatar><AvatarImage src={url} alt={name} /><AvatarFallback>AG</AvatarFallback></Avatar>
- **Badge** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Badge.tsx#Badge` [primitive] render a small rounded pill label with a styled variant Use: <Badge variant="secondary">Active</Badge>
- **Breadcrumb** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Breadcrumb.tsx#Breadcrumb` [primitive] render an accessible breadcrumb trail nav for page hierarchy Use: <Breadcrumb><BreadcrumbList><BreadcrumbItem>…</BreadcrumbItem></BreadcrumbList></Breadcrumb>
- **Button** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Button.tsx#Button` [primitive] render a styled button that hides or disables itself by permission Use: <Button variant="outline" show={() => can('edit')} disabledText="No access">Save</Button>
- **buttonVariants** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Button.tsx#buttonVariants` [primitive] produce Button class names by variant and size for non-button elements styled as buttons Use: import { buttonVariants } from '@ui/components/primitives/Button'; cn(buttonVariants({ variant }))
- **Card** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Card.tsx#Card` [primitive] wrap content in a bordered card panel, optionally hidden via show flag or function Use: <Card show={canView}><CardHeader><CardTitle>…</CardTitle></CardHeader><CardContent>…</CardContent></Card>
- **cn** `packages/shared/src/utils/cn.ts#cn` [primitive] merge conditional Tailwind class names, resolving conflicts Use: className={cn('px-2', isActive && 'bg-primary', className)}
- **cn** `packages/ui/src/lib/utils.ts#cn` [primitive] merge conditional Tailwind class names, resolving conflicting utilities Use: className={cn('px-2', isActive && 'bg-primary', className)}
- **ComingSoon** `packages/ui/src/components/utility/ComingSoon.tsx#ComingSoon` [primitive] show a placeholder card for unbuilt features Use: <ComingSoon title="Reports" description="..." icon={Icon} />
- **CopyButton** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/CopyButton.tsx#CopyButton` [primitive] copy a value to the clipboard with a button showing copied feedback Use: <CopyButton value={token} label="Copy" />
- **DropdownMenu** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/DropdownMenu.tsx#DropdownMenu` [primitive] provide an Ariakit menu context wrapping trigger and content of a dropdown Use: <DropdownMenu><DropdownMenuTrigger>…</DropdownMenuTrigger><DropdownMenuContent>…</DropdownMenuContent></DropdownMenu>

- **formatEnumLabel** `packages/ui/src/lib/enumOptions.ts#formatEnumLabel` [primitive] convert a camelCase or snake_case enum value into a spaced human label Use: formatEnumLabel(value)
- **Input** `packages/ui/src/components/primitives/Input.tsx#Input` [primitive] text input that can hide via show or disable with a disabledText placeholder Use: <Input value={v} onChange={e => set(e.target.value)} disabledText={locked ? 'Locked' : undefined} />
- **InviteUserModal** `packages/ui/src/components/users/InviteUserModal.tsx#InviteUserModal` [primitive] collect an email and role to invite a user, in a modal Use: <InviteUserModal isOpen={open} onClose={close} onSubmit={(email, role) => invite(email, role)} />

- **ProfileFormCard** `packages/ui/src/components/settings/ProfileFormCard.tsx#ProfileFormCard` [primitive] edit name and slug on profile pages, optionally with the theme picker Use: <ProfileFormCard name={name} onNameChange={setName} slug={slug} showThemeToggle />
